description: Joins two or more faces from one run into a single person — for somebody who walked out of the shot and came back. REFUSED when any two of them appear on the same frame, since they cannot then be one person. The earliest face's id and name survive, so existing bindings keep working, and the time between sightings stays a gap for the clip's gap policy to handle.

faceIds.description: Two or more faceIds within that run.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: merge_faces
title: Merge faces
